3. Nanu śrutānumānāgocaro'pi viśeṣo laukikapratyakṣeṇaiva grāhyo'stu kiṃ yogajapratyakṣeṇeti
tatrāha-- na cāsyeti / Nanv evaṃ tasya viśeṣasyāprāmāṇikatvād abhāva evāstv ity āśaṅkāṃ
pratiṣedhati-- na cāsya viśeṣasyeti / Na hi nirviśeṣaṃ sāmānyam astīti nyāyena sarvatraiva vastuni
viśeṣasiddher iti bhāvaḥ / Ataḥ pariśeṣāt samādhiprajñāgrāhya eva sa viśeṣa ity upasaṃharati-- iti
samādhīti / Sthūlasya viśeṣaḥ kadācil laukikapratyakṣagocaro'pi syād iti sthūlaṃ parityajya
bhūtasūkṣmagataḥ ity uktam / Puruṣagato veti / Etena puruṣeṣv api viśeṣādidharmaḥ svīkṛtaḥ,
